I've already asked this in /v/CSS, but nobody answered. I want multiple theme options aside from the standard day- / night-mode themes.
Is there any way I can include multiple CSS theme options in my subverse?
I don't think you currently can. I know the way reddit does it is like TM.reddit.com/r/subredditname with TM being the theme version. I don't think Voat currently supports that however.

You could host the CSS on an external server, then include a login system on that server. Have a default theme, then at the end of the custom style sheet, add an "@import" tag linking to the external server. Make it so the server doesn't give any code unless the user is logged in. Then add a button somewhere before the @import tag that directs the user to your server to login and select the theme.

This is probably the only way it can be done.
